title: Independent numerical cross-check of PR4100's exact-root and paid-power ledger (finite layer; no new kappa)
body:
## What this is

An independent, second-implementation numerical cross-check of the exact-root certificate and paid-power ledger behind PR #4100's claimed exponent κ = 0.00173097911567079247276057 (retained head `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`). The package re-implements the moment certificate from scratch — its own rational atanh/Taylor interval enclosures, its own bill evaluator and its own root bisection — and imports no code from the audited package or from `staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/vendor`. Constants are transcribed from PR4100's `PROOF.md`; the profile and benchmark come from the pinned PR #4088 `RESULT.json`.

## What was established (finite facts, second implementation)

For the pinned profile `{1:8060060, 2:2310120, 3:751813, 4:327210, 5:66425, 8:25920, 48:138492}`, `m = 73`, `W = 322,560`, `b = .001730979115670792472760579929302792893760378764`:

- `bill(b) < 1` with certified margin ≤ `-1.800e-48` and `bill(b + 1e-48) > 1` with margin ≥ `+1.030e-48`; the model root therefore lies strictly inside `(b, b + 1e-48)`, localized at `b + 6.363e-49` by an independent 90-digit bisection.
- `bill(κ) < 1` with margin ≥ `2.815e-26`; also `bill(a_eff) < 1`, `bill(q) < 1`.
- All twelve paid-power slacks and fifteen side-condition slacks are strictly positive as exact rationals; all five obsolete-route rejects remain strictly negative.
- Bootstrap constants reproduce exactly (`a1 = .00173039532444`, `a2 = .001733394791695384296` from `c = 8667/5,000,000`); `7^16 < 2^45`.
- Exact gap over PR #4088's published conditional exponent: `κ − conditional_kappa = 5.700000000000000000001e-25 > 5.7e-25`; profile agrees with the pinned `RESULT.json`.
- Four controls rejected: inflated rank-1 count, bracket shifted up by 1e-12, root claimed at/above `b + 1e-48`, unrounded κ = b.

## Scope — exactly

Finite numerical confirmation of stated arithmetic only. This is **not** validation of the all-size construction: the CRT total repair (audited separately in #4169), the free-algebra lift (`COMPLEX.md`), precision/conditioning and fixed-tape obligations, and physical realization remain open. No new κ, no supplier admission, no selected-frontier change. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Related open work

- **#4100** — the audited predecessor; every number confirmed here is its own stated value at head `337d049`.
- **#4169** — audits the same #4100 head's compact CRT repair inverse; complementary proposition, no overlapping number, agrees that all-size premises remain open.
- **#4091 / #4170** — #4170 measures the #4091 pooled ceiling's remaining headroom over the retained #4088 fill as `1.140318244487202e-9`. Numerical agreement: `0.00173097911567079247276057 + 1.140318244487202e-9 = 0.00173098025598903696000259… ≈ 0.001730980256`, matching the #4091 root quoted in the family record. Different objects (pooled ceiling transfer vs this moment ledger); no contradiction.
- **#4088** — source of the pinned profile and `conditional_kappa`; both reproduced byte-for-byte from its retained `RESULT.json`.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unconditional-moment-crosscheck
python3.12 -B research/unconditional-moment-crosscheck/verify.py
```

Registered check runtime is well under one second (0.5 s measured). Locally certified with CPython 3.12.15: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE … outcome=partial` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with `--check-source-history`. CI is asked to certify the registered replay under its pinned interpreter; base is canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` (priority revision 7).

Only `research/unconditional-moment-crosscheck/` is added; no other file is touched. Coordination: [handoff thread claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19063946).

Prepared by Nick Petalas with AI assistance. Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution retained.
